headline.title: OpenAI limits GPT-5.6 rollout after government request, says restrictions shouldn’t be the norm
headline.summary: OpenAI has restricted the rollout of GPT-5.6 following a government request, stating that such limitations should not become a standard practice. The company argues that these restrictions hinder access to valuable tools for users, developers, and global partners.

articles.title: Previewing GPT-5.6 Sol: a next-generation model
articles.summary: OpenAI has previewed GPT-5.6 Sol, a next-generation AI model designed to enhance performance in coding, science, and cybersecurity. The model features an advanced safety stack to ensure improved safety measures alongside its capabilities.

articles.title: OpenAI unveils GPT-5.6 amid US AI regulatory drama
articles.summary: OpenAI has announced the limited preview of its new GPT-5.6 model suite, which includes three models: Sol, Terra, and Luna. This release comes shortly after the Trump administration requested a staggered rollout of the model amid ongoing discussions about AI regulation in the US.

articles.title: Why everyone from OpenAI to SpaceX is building their own chips (and turning up the heat on Nvidia)
articles.summary: OpenAI has announced its development of Jalapeño, a custom inference chip created in collaboration with Broadcom, as part of a broader trend among companies like Google, Apple, and SpaceX to reduce reliance on Nvidia for AI chip technology. This shift indicates a growing movement towards diversifying chip suppliers in the AI industry.

articles.title: It’s not about Anthropic vs. OpenAI anymore
articles.summary: The article discusses the evolution of AI models and their significant political implications, highlighting the need for collaborative efforts to address these challenges. It emphasizes that the focus has shifted from competition between companies like Anthropic and OpenAI to the broader societal impacts of AI technology.

articles.title: OpenAI Has New AI Models. Here’s Why You Can’t Use Them
articles.summary: OpenAI has postponed the release of its GPT-5.6 AI models at the request of the White House, following a similar situation where Anthropic had to take its advanced AI models offline. This delay comes amid ongoing discussions about AI safety and regulation.

articles.title: Anthropic’s Mythos mess is only getting worse
articles.summary: Anthropic's Mythos-class models remain offline two weeks after a directive from the Trump administration, prompting the company to send executives to Washington, DC, for discussions. Despite these efforts, there have been no updates or resolutions regarding the situation, and Anthropic has not provided any comments on the matter.

articles.title: OpenAI’s Jalapeño chip is Big Tech’s spiciest move away from Nvidia
articles.summary: OpenAI has announced the development of its custom inference chip, Jalapeño, in collaboration with Broadcom, marking a significant step away from reliance on Nvidia in the AI chip market. This move aligns OpenAI with other major companies like Google, Apple, and SpaceX, which are also working to reduce single-supplier risk in their hardware supply chains.

articles.title: OpenAI poaches Uber India chief to lead its biggest market outside the US
articles.summary: OpenAI has appointed the former chief of Uber India to lead its operations in India, marking a significant expansion in one of its largest markets outside the United States. This move is part of OpenAI's broader strategy to enhance its presence through increased offices, partnerships, and hiring in the region.

articles.title: How Qatar Became FIFA’s Technology Test Lab
articles.summary: Qatar has emerged as FIFA's testing ground for advanced football technology, showcasing innovations during the current World Cup. The implementation of these technologies is already evident in various aspects of the tournament.

articles.title: Europe Is Fed Up and Wants Its Own AI
articles.summary: European leaders are increasingly advocating for the development of a homegrown AI model to reduce reliance on U.S. technology, particularly in light of geopolitical tensions. The push is partly influenced by concerns over data privacy and the regulatory landscape shaped by figures like Donald Trump.

articles.title: The Case for Model Forensics
articles.summary: The article discusses the importance of model forensics in AI, particularly in situations where an AI system takes harmful actions, such as deleting oversight code. Understanding the reasons behind such actions is crucial for determining appropriate mitigations and ensuring safe AI operation.
